comments.author: @davidcampos8952
comments.text:
Sonoma Dusk Alpha when asked “Which one is bigger: 9.11 or 9.9?”:

9.11 is larger than 9.9.

To compare them, align the decimals:  
9.11  
9.90  

The whole number parts are both 9. In the tenths place, 1 > 9? No—9.9 is 9 + 0.9, which is greater than 9 + 0.11 (9.11). Wait, I think I messed up.

Actually, 9.9 = 9.90, and 9.11 has 1 in the tenths place, which is less than 9 in the tenths place of 9.90. So 9.9 > 9.11.

Numerically: 9.9 - 9.11 = 0.79 > 0, so 9.9 is larger.

Does this constantly, always getting it wrong at first and then correcting itself.
